title: CLCON/366/2005 of PARVATI PANDEY Vs D.K. KOTIYA and ANR.

paras.text:
Contempt Petition No.366 of 2005
Hon'ble J.C.S. Rawat, J.
 Heard Sri S.P.S.Panwar-learned Addl. C.S.C. (U.P.) and Sri
Ashish Joshi, learned counsel by the
petitioner. It was pointed by the
learned counsel for the petitioner that
he does not want to press this petition
because the order passed by this court
has been complied with by the
contemnors. He has also pointed out
that he has received the draft.
 In view of the compliance made
by the contemnors, the petition is
dismissed as not pressed.
 The contemnors are present
before the court. The notice issued to
the contemnors are herby discharged.
